# dependent-count

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./singularity build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Per-row "N blocked" chip on a conversation item: how many tasks are transitively blocked by that conversation's task. The conversation toolbar shows the same count inside its Tasks button instead of as a chip of its own.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Item.Chips` → `DependentCountItemChip`
  - Uses:
    - `conversations/conversation-ui/item.Item`
    - `primitives/css/badge.Badge`
    - `tasks.useActiveDependentCount`
